subject: Action: Prevent demo blackout during APAC Golden Week + EU bank closures
messages:
From: Anna Ryu <anna.ryu@kirinbio.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Scheduling <scheduling@kirinbio.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Demo series — request to avoid regional blackout windows

Hi Sean / Laura / Marcus,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. We are trying to lock in the three-part demo series for our global product committee (US/EMEA/APAC attendees). A couple of blockers popped up on our side that could leave us short-handed for some sessions:

- India office: Diwali week (tentative OOO window Nov 25–29, 2026).
- Japan/JP ops: internal Golden Week planning (their fiscal planning block is late Apr–early May 2027).
- EU regional stakeholders: multiple bank holidays around Easter 2027 (April 6–9, 2027 depending on country).

Current proposed sessions are recurring weekly on Thursdays starting Dec 2 through May. With the overlap of Diwali and the Golden Week planning, we risk having no APAC coverage on several demos and several EU stakeholders will be out around the April window. Can we avoid booking slots that create a "blackout" for APAC + EU simultaneously?

What would help from Redwood:
- A short proposal of alternate windows that align with US morning / EU late morning / APAC afternoon coverage, or a rotation plan that preserves one cross-region slot per week.
- Confirmation of which Redwood team members would attend each slot (we need CS + Solutions + Sales).

I've attached our internal availability export (kirin_availability.ics) and a quick notes sheet with preffered times.

Thanks — happy to be flexible but want to avoid repeated reschedules once we publish to the committees.

Best,
Anna
Anna Ryu
Head of Product Ops, Kirin Bio
anna.ryu@kirinbio.com

----
Attachments: kirin_availability.ics (calendar export)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Ryu <anna.ryu@kirinbio.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo series — request to avoid regional blackout windows

Anna — thanks for the heads up and the calendar file. Really appreciate the context.

Short answer: yes, we can propose a rotation and specific avoidance windows so you don't end up with back-to-back no-shows across regions. I've sketched three options and attached a CSV with candidate slots (proposed_windows.csv). High-level:

1) Fixed cross-region slot: One slot per week that sits at 14:00 UTC (US EDT morning / EU mid-morning / APAC late evening) — good for leadership but late for APAC EMEA late-night.
2) Rotating windows (preferred): Rotate the cross-region slot across three weeks so each region gets the reasonable local time once every three weeks. This reduces APAC late-evening fatigue.
3) Split demos by audience: Run two shorter sessions the same day — one focused on APAC + EMEA (their daytime) and a second for US-focused follow-up. This doubles coordination but keeps local-friendly times.

Operational asks from our side:
- CS coverage: Marissa confirms she can staff the rotating model if we keep one week notice on the published schedule.
- Solutions: Marcus can lead the APAC-facing sessions but will need to swap if a Golden Week conflict appears in late April/early May — please mark those weeks as potential swap candidates.

Can you confirm which of the three options you'd prefer, and any hard blackout dates (besides the Diwali week you mentioned)? I'll push a clean schedule and an explicit attendee matrix once you confirm.

Sean Gallagher
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0194

----
Attachments: proposed_windows.csv (candidate slots)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Demo series — request to avoid regional blackout windows

Quick note on coverage:

- I can staff up to two rotating sessions per week through March if we get the schedule to me at least 7 days in advance.
- For late-April/early-May (potential JP Golden Week conflicts), I recommend we lock an APAC backup facilitator (Soojin) for those specific weeks — Soojin, can you confirm you'll take those if needed?

Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Yes — I can take the Golden Week swap and can run either 14:00 UTC or a later APAC-friendly slot.

Marissa

Thanks, Sean and team — rotating windows sounds like the right balance. Kirin prefers option 2 (rotating windows). Confirmed hard blackout for Diwali week (Nov 25–29) and for the APAC fiscal planning block Apr 28–May 5 (Golden Week–adjacent for our JP ops team). EU Easter blackout: please avoid Apr 6–9.

Next steps from our side: I attached a published ICS with the committee meeting schedule (kirin_availability.ics) and accepted your proposed rotation for the first six sessions — can you publish the attendee matrix and the first three made-live calendar invites? We will route those to the product committee.

Anna
